target_sources(Test_Main
    PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/FoxgloveDecoderTest.cpp
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/JpegDecoderTest.cpp
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/McapSourceTest.cpp
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/PlaybackTest.cpp
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ProtoReaderTest.cpp
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/TransformTreeTest.cpp
)
target_link_libraries(Test_Main PRIVATE Camelot_data)

# McapSourceTest opens the recording generated by Tests/fixtures/make_fixture.py.
target_compile_definitions(Test_Main
                           PRIVATE CAMELOT_TEST_FIXTURES_DIR="${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Tests/fixtures")
